note: Louisa County (IA) lists zoning districts (A-1, B-1, C-1, F-1, I-1, R-1) only through its Schneider Beacon GIS viewer, which is behind a Cloudflare challenge and has no public ArcGIS REST zoning service. ArcGIS search found no Louisa zoning layer; Wapello and Columbus Junction have no published zoning GIS layer found; Des Moines County's dmcwebgis host has no Louisa layer.
